meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动创建带根因分析和复现步骤的缺陷报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在GitHub仓库中提交高质量Bug Issue或修复PR。
copy.tagline_en: Automatically create bug reports with root cause analysis and reproduction steps
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to file high-signal bug issues or fix PRs in GitHub repos.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude可以根据你的bug报告自动调查根因，产生带证据的GitHub issue或PR，并路由到正确的仓库（code-yeongyu/lazycodex或openai/codex）。
howto.when: 当你要求报告、提交、打开或分类LazyCodex、Codex插件、OMO-Codex、Codex CLI等相关bug时，尤其需要基于源代码的根因和修复指导时触发。

say.text: 为Codex CLI创建一个issue，描述配置加载失败。
say.note: 如果只在上游复现，会路由到openai/codex。

say.text: 检查openai/codex上有没有类似bug的现有issue。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automatically investigate root cause based on your bug report, produce a GitHub issue or PR with evidence, and route it to the correct repository (code-yeongyu/lazycodex or openai/codex).
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to report, file, open, or triage bugs related to LazyCodex, Codex plugin, OMO-Codex, Codex CLI, etc., especially when source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, and fix guidance are needed.

say_en.text: Report a bug in the LazyCodex installer.
say_en.note: Claude will investigate and create an issue in code-yeongyu/lazycodex.

say_en.text: Create an issue for Codex CLI describing a config loading failure.
say_en.note: If it reproduces only upstream, it will be routed to openai/codex.

say_en.text: Check for existing issues on openai/codex about this bug.
say_en.note: Claude will search and avoid duplicates.
